target_customer: Independent healthcare practices that outsource medical billing
problem: Independent practices lose time and revenue to coding review, claim errors, denials, appeals and patient billing that they handle with small staffs.
business_model: AI-native medical billing partner, end to end service (pricing not public)
product_category: AI medical billing and revenue cycle for independent practices

founders.name: Nanda Guntupalli
founders.background_notes: YC page: built RL environments for operating EHRs at Refresh; grew up doing billing at his parents' medical practice.

founders.name: Adam Wax
education: Studying computer science and math full-time (school not named)
founders.background_notes: YC page: built healthcare RL environments at Refresh supporting a $2M frontier AI lab contract, and CMS workflows at Hearst used by 2,600+ editors.

competitors.name: Procode AI
competitors.what: AI-powered revenue cycle management for surgical billing
competitors.traction_then: Launched out of stealth in March 2026

competitors.name: Freed Coding Assistant
competitors.what: AI tool helping independent practices capture accurate reimbursement from encounters

competitors.name: Arintra
competitors.what: Autonomous medical coding expanding to revenue assurance

technical_complexity.rationale: End-to-end billing across many EHRs and payers needs integrations, coding accuracy and denial handling, standard but wide engineering work.

defensibility.rationale: Billing as a managed service and EHR integrations create some stickiness, but many funded AI billing vendors target the same practices.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Too early to say. Practice management vendors added AI billing features in 2026.

market_need_then: The company site shows testimonials from small practices, and 2026 press shows heavy funding and launches in AI billing, with one analyst noting most platforms were built for large systems rather than independent practices.

branding.domain_note: Uses taigabilling.com with a billing suffix; legal entity is Bayes AI, Inc. and a usetaiga.com domain also appears in third-party listings.

identity.voice_and_tone: Warm and personal: The medical billing partner you want to work with

branding.brand_signature: Founders' story of growing up in their parents' practices

brand_strength.rationale: A real-word name with a personal founder story and named practice testimonials, but the word taiga is generic and no press about the brand was found.

outcome_analysis: Taiga is a Spring 2026 YC company that is active and has no outcome yet. The founders grew up in medical practices and show early testimonials, while the main risk is a crowded set of funded AI billing vendors and practice management incumbents.
notes: Caplight lists $500,000 from Y Combinator as Accelerator dated 2026-03-01, a single aggregator, not recorded as a round. No priced round or press release found. Outcome search found nothing about Taiga or Bayes AI. Competitor dates are snippet dates from 2025 to 2026 launches and Arintra predates the batch. Completeness pass: The $500K accelerator round rests on a single database (Caplight; F4 Fund also listed as an investor, not recorded). Cross-check search found no primary source.
